page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8ia.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor, operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 6.0 GB of RAM per core. For accelerated workloads, the instance integrates a single NVIDIA L20 GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, which delivers 48 GB of dedicated VRAM.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 40 Gbps, facilitating efficient data transfer between the instance and external storage or other network resources. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of a high-vCPU AMD EPYC processor and a specialized NVIDIA L20 GPU offers a balanced resource density for organizations requiring GPU acceleration without the premium cost associated with flagship deep learning accelerators.

The hardware configuration makes the ecs.gn8ia.16xlarge suitable for workloads such as mid-range AI inference, graphics rendering, video transcoding, and high-performance computing tasks that benefit from GPU acceleration. The 48 GB of VRAM on the NVIDIA L20 GPU allows for hosting moderately sized machine learning models, while the 64 dedicated vCPUs handle concurrent preprocessing and data pipeline tasks.
